 No dedicated discussion or citation of this text appears in the secondary literature surveyed in the dossier.

 However, DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse, detecting 72 matching passages across 26 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Substantial textual overlap occurs with the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo), which preserves 12 matches (especially spanning segments §0.3–2.4) [DharmaNexus]. The text also exhibits near-verbatim structural identity with an earlier homonymous poem in the collection, *Pilakkhaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 386), covering segments §0.2–7.1 with a similarity score of 0.96 [DharmaNexus]. Additionally, widespread shared stock formulas link segments §2.2–7.1 to various other fruit-donation apadānas, including the *Tālaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 511), *Vallikāraphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 480), *Piyālaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 502), and *Nāḷikeraphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 512) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
